q: Why did my video come out at a lower resolution?
a: A small file has room for only so much detail. Rather than a blocky 1080p video, the tool scales it down so it looks clean. Pick a bigger size or trim the clip to keep more resolution.

q: It says my browser cannot do it.
a: Use a current Chrome, Edge or Safari. Not every browser can read every video format.
